description: Lignes de bus Nomad car à Roumois Seine is a dataset listed in Roumoiseine open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Normandie. Les lignes de bus du réseau de mobilité Nomad en Roumois Seine. Coverage: Roumois Seine (Eure). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Mobilité, Transport, Car, Bus, Transport urbain. The portal shows 77 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roumoiseine-fr-portal.
